representation_fit.evidence: Layered SVG network graph matches the relational-web shape bundle (many, high relationality, medium hierarchy): 6 labeled lanes + 33 nodes + 58 edges (source/data.js:7-61); relationships are first-class objects — edges have hit areas, edge cards with type/protocol/criticality (source/app.js:313-341, app.js:388-390), satisfying object_type=relationship.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen is dominated by the dependency graph in both viewports; the header states the job ('理解关系结构：依赖与影响，可跟随、不丢失全局', source/index.html:17) and the 相邻/依赖闭包/影响闭包 lens toggle floats over the canvas (source/index.html:40-44; screenshots 1280x860, 1440x900).

time_to_understand.evidence: Fast orientation: legend decodes line types and P0/P1/P2 chips (source/index.html:52-59), direction convention spelled out ('A → B 表示 A 依赖 B', overview panel in both screenshots, source/app.js:140), hub nodes and P0 key chains distilled in the panel (source/app.js:248-282). Deducted for the dense 58-edge crossing mass and a stray empty gray pill at canvas top-center in both viewports (see defects).

navigation_cost.evidence: Single-screen app, no modes to traverse: any node reachable in one click (source/app.js:385-392) or one search Enter (source/app.js:435-438); any relationship in one click on an edge or via panel P0 chain buttons (source/app.js:256-261); reset via button or Esc (source/index.html:25, app.js:497).

context_loss.evidence: Acceptance seed engineered in: focus dims unrelated elements to opacity 0.13 and never hides them (source/styles.css:138,161; legend hint index.html:58); following accumulates a breadcrumb with prefix backtracking (source/app.js:196-222); selecting an edge preserves the follow path (source/app.js:372); Esc/blank-click unwind without discarding state (source/app.js:391); path+mode deep-link in the hash (source/app.js:502-527).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent controls are purposeful (search, 3 lenses, 3 zoom buttons, legend, reset; source/index.html:20-50) and selftest.js:22-43 shows all data ships inline so no loading scaffolding exists. Slight over-richness: overview panel carries 6 stacked sections and the full 58-edge web renders at once, a busy first impression (both screenshots).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt checks a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=pass (measurement-summary.json). Consistent with source: minimum text at 10-11.5px (stat labels styles.css:291, type badges :308, crit chips :312, lane counts :116) and the entire graph is pointer-only — no tabindex/keyboard path on .node-g/.edge-g groups (source/app.js:94-106). Mitigation present: :focus-visible outlines (styles.css:41) and aria-labels on search/svg/groups (index.html:21,30,40).

frontend_rework.evidence: Visible defect: an empty stray pill at canvas top-center in BOTH screenshots — #tracebar carries the hidden attribute (source/index.html:38) but .tracebar{display:flex} (source/styles.css:213) overrides it, so the empty container paints. Receipt adds 3 failing checks implying rework (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, type.min_projected_size in measurement-summary.json), while layout.overflow/responsive_collision/text.truncation all pass.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' is explicitly implemented and self-verified: source/app.js:2-4 cites it as the core contract; dim-not-hide enforced in CSS (styles.css:161); closure lenses (app.js:146-155) add meaning without view replacement; selftest.js:52-58 asserts no display:none nodes and selftest.js:102-110 asserts edge selection preserves the 3-step breadcrumb; overview '怎么用' restates it (app.js:282). Brief constraints (static index.html, ready at load, one main screen) also met (app.js:529-533).

defects_observed: Empty tracebar renders as a stray gray pill at canvas top-center in both 1280x860 and 1440x900 screenshots: #tracebar has the hidden attribute (source/index.html:38) but .tracebar{display:flex} (source/styles.css:213) defeats it.
Receipt a11y.contrast=fail and type.min_projected_size=fail, matching 10-11.5px minimum type sizes and low-contrast muted grays in source/styles.css (lines 116, 291, 308, 312).
Receipt a11y.focus_order=fail; graph nodes/edges are SVG groups with pointer-only interaction and no keyboard access (source/app.js:94-106, 385-392).
scores.overall_note: This package is a purpose-built relational-web browser whose primary representation (layered 6-lane, 33-node/58-edge SVG graph with relationships as clickable first-class objects) fits the brief's shape bundle closely, and its central interaction — follow with accumulating breadcrumbs while unrelated elements dim to 0.13 opacity but never hide — directly implements the acceptance seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文', backed by in-page self-tests asserting context preservation (source/selftest.js:52-58, 102-110). Navigation cost is minimal (one screen, one click to any node or edge, search, Esc reset), and the initial screen communicates the job via subtitle, legend, direction convention, and an overview panel distilling hubs and P0 chains. The weaknesses are execution polish: a hidden-but-still-rendered empty tracebar leaves a stray pill on the first screen in both viewports (styles.css:213 defeating index.html:38), and three of the seven receipt checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, type.min_projected_size), consistent with sub-12px minimum text, muted low-contrast labels, and a pointer-only graph. Accessibility is therefore the clear low point (2/5), with visible-defect/rework exposure at 2/5; everything observable about fit, salience, navigation, context preservation, and seed coverage scores at the top of the scale. As required by the rubric, task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference were not scored — no user study exists, and model judgment of this screen is not human preference.
